map.三项分别按方向计算裕度：断裂强力与伸长率用「(实测 − 下限) / 下限 × 1: Each item gets a margin by direction: breaking force and elongation use (measured − lower limit) / lower limit × 100%; abrasion loss uses (upper limit − measured) / upper limit × 100%.
